author: Neha Kulkarni
alert_description: checkout-api p99 latency is 6,049 ms on POST /v1/checkout (threshold 2,000 ms)

details.diff: recreates ledger_entries as a range-partitioned table (by created_at); indexes created: (id), (created_at)

discriminators: postgres-ledger CPU is pinned above 85%, so the database itself is the bottleneck
slow-query log shows a sequential scan on ledger_entries
slow queries per minute jump by two orders of magnitude
a schema migration ran on postgres-ledger just before the onset

steps.note: saw the Seq Scan, remembered INC-4186 and did not touch the pool; created the index

migration_context: 12 days after the PgBouncer migration (M1, 3 Sep); 5 days after the Redis to Valkey migration (M2, 10 Sep)
